verses.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੁ ਵਡਾ ਰਾਜਾ ਜਨਕੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: bhagat vaddaa raajaa janak hai gurmukh maiaa vich udhaasee|

en.bdb: King Janak was a great saint who amidst maya remained indifferent to it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵ ਲੋਕ ਨੋ ਚਲਿਆ ਗਣ ਗੰਧਰਬੁ ਸਭਾ ਸੁਖਵਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: dhev lok no chaliaa gan ga(n)dharab sabhaa sukhavaasee|

en.bdb: Along with gans and gandharvs (calestial musicians) he went to the abode of the gods.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਮਪੁਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਸੁਣਿ ਵਿਲਲਾਵਨਿ ਜੀਅ ਨਰਕ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: jamapur giaa pukaar sun vilalaavan jeea narak nivaasee|

en.bdb: From there, he, hearing the cries of inhabitants of hell, went to them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧਰਮਰਾਇ ਨੋ ਆਖਿਓਨੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਦੀ ਕਰਿ ਬੰਦ ਖਲਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: dharamarai no aakhion sabhanaa dhee kar ba(n)dh khalaasee|

en.bdb: He asked the god of death, Dharamrai, to relieve all their suffering.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰੇ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਧਰਮਰਾਇ ਹਉ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: kare benatee dharamarai hau sevak Thaakur abinaasee|

en.bdb: Hearing this, the god of death told him he was a mere servant of the eternal Lord (and without His orders he could not liberate them).

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਹਿਣੇ ਧਰਿਓਨੁ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਪਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਰਜਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: gahine dharion ik naau paapaa naal karai nirajaasee|

en.bdb: Janak offered a part of his devotion and remembrance of the name of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਪੁ ਨ ਪੁਜਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਉ ਅਤੁਲ ਨ ਤੁਲਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: paasa(n)g paap na pujanee gurmukh naau atul na tulaasee|

en.bdb: All the sins of hell were found not equal even to the counterweight of balance.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਰਕਹੁ ਛੁਟੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਕਟੀ ਗਲਹੰੁ ਸਿਲਕ ਜਮ ਫਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: narakahu chhuTe jeea ja(n)t kaTee galaha(n) silak jam faasee|

en.bdb: In fact no balance can weigh the fruits of recitation and remembrance of the Lords name by the gurmukh.
All the creatures got liberated from hell and the noose of death was cut.  Liberation and the technique of attaining it are the servants of the name of the Lord.
